s: Thinly slice the cabbage and onion, and chop the garlic.
In a large deep skillet, brown the ground beef in the oil for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Cook the onion and cabbage for 8 minutes over medium-high heat, stirring, until they start to brown.
Add the garlic, spices, tomatoes, broth and the meat; season with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the cabbage is tender.
Sprinkle with dill and serve.
l04-chou-farci-viande-hachee.p: All the flavor of stuffed cabbage without the shaping: ready in 45 minutes and even better reheated.

l04-agneau-curry-coco.t: Lamb Curry with Coconut Milk and Spinach
i: curry powder, garam masala and turmeric
s: Brown the lamb in 2 batches in the coconut oil, then set aside.
Cook the chopped onion for 6 minutes, add the grated garlic and ginger, then the spices; stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, lamb, water and salt. Cover and simmer for 1 hour over low heat.
Pour in the coconut milk and continue cooking, uncovered, for 20 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 3 minutes.
Serve sprinkled with cilantro, with cauliflower rice.
l04-agneau-curry-coco.p: Lamb shoulder is ideal here: its fat melts during cooking and makes the sauce creamy.

s: Finely chop the parsley, cilantro and garlic. Mix with 3 tbsp of the oil, the vinegar, oregano, chili flakes and salt. Let rest for 15 minutes.
Cut the bell pepper and zucchini into strips, toss them with the remaining oil and grill for 6 minutes in a grill pan.
Salt the steak and sear it on a very hot grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly on the diagonal, against the grain.
Serve with the grilled vegetables and spoon the chimichurri over the top.
l04-steak-chimichurri.p: Chimichurri keeps for 3 days in the fridge and also brightens up eggs or fish.

l04-aubergines-farcies-boeuf-yaourt.t: Roasted Eggplants Stuffed with Beef and Yogurt
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Halve the eggplants, score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern, brush with oil, salt, and roast cut side up for 25 minutes.
Cook the chopped onion and the beef for 8 minutes, add the garlic, spices and diced tomato; cook for 5 minutes.
Lightly mash the eggplant flesh with a fork to form a hollow.
Fill with the meat mixture and return to the oven for 10 minutes.
Serve topped with salted yogurt, sprinkled with mint and pistachios.
l04-aubergines-farcies-boeuf-yaourt.p: Inspired by the Turkish karnıyarık: you can swap the beef for ground lamb.

l04-bowl-boeuf-cumin-riz-chou-fleur.t: Cumin Ground Beef Bowl with Cauliflower Rice
s: Grate the cauliflower into rice-sized grains and sauté for 5 minutes over high heat with half the oil and salt, then add a squeeze of lime.
In another pan, brown the beef with the diced bell pepper and the remaining oil for 8 minutes.
Add the spices and 3 tbsp water; let it reduce for 2 minutes, then season with salt.
Slice the avocado and drizzle with lime juice.
Assemble the bowls: cauliflower rice, meat, avocado, cheddar, crème fraîche and cilantro.
l04-bowl-boeuf-cumin-riz-chou-fleur.p: Prepare the rice and meat ahead for 3 days of lunches; add the avocado at the last moment.

l04-brochettes-boeuf-soja-sesame.t: Soy and Sesame Marinated Beef Skewers
s: Mix the soy sauce, oil, ginger, grated garlic and 1 tbsp sesame seeds; set aside 1 tbsp of this mixture for the salad. Marinate the beef in the rest for 30 minutes.
Cut the bell pepper into squares and the scallions into 3 cm pieces; leave the mushrooms whole.
Slice the cabbage very thinly and dress it with the vinegar, the reserved marinade and the remaining sesame seeds.
Thread the skewers, alternating beef, bell pepper, mushroom and scallion.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning them, and brush with the remaining marinade halfway through.
Serve on the crunchy cabbage salad.
l04-brochettes-boeuf-soja-sesame.p: Never reuse raw marinade that has touched the meat; the marinade used for basting cooks on the grill.

l04-cotelettes-agneau-moutarde-gratin-ch.t: Mustard-Crusted Rack of Lamb with Cauliflower Gratin
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Steam the cauliflower florets for 8 minutes, then place them in a dish with the cream, Emmental, salt and pepper.
Season the racks with salt and pepper, then sear them fat side down for 3 minutes in the oil, and 1 minute on the other sides.
Mix the almond flour, chopped parsley and grated garlic.
Brush the tops of the racks with mustard and press the almond crumbs onto them.
Roast the racks and the gratin together for 15 to 18 minutes for pink meat.
Let the meat rest for 5 minutes, carve between the bones and serve with the gratin.
l04-cotelettes-agneau-moutarde-gratin-ch.p: Ask the butcher to French-trim the racks (bones cleaned) for a nice presentation.

l04-merguez-brochettes-legumes.t: Merguez and Vegetable Skewers with Harissa-Yogurt Sauce
s: Cut the merguez into 4 cm pieces, the zucchini into thick slices, and the bell pepper and onion into squares.
Thread 8 skewers, alternating merguez and vegetables, finishing with a cherry tomato.
Brush the vegetables with oil and season lightly with salt.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes on the barbecue or under the oven broiler, turning regularly.
Mix the yogurt, harissa and lemon juice, and serve the sauce with the skewers.
l04-merguez-brochettes-legumes.p: Adjust the harissa for the kids: serve a mild version of the sauce without harissa on the side.

i: thick-cut veal shank slices (~1.4 kg with bone)
s: Snip the membrane around the slices so they don't curl. Season with salt and pepper and lightly dust with almond flour.
Brown the slices for 4 minutes per side in the oil and butter in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery, finely diced, for 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and broth, and return the meat in a single layer. Cover and simmer for 1 hour 45 minutes over low heat, turning halfway through.
Make the gremolata: chop the parsley, lemon zest and garlic together.
Serve the meat topped with sauce and sprinkled with gremolata.
l04-osso-buco-veau-gremolata.p: The marrow inside the bone is a treat: serve a small spoon for enjoying it.

l04-steaks-haches-champignons-puree-broc.t: Beef Patties with Mushroom Sauce and Broccoli Mash
s: Steam the broccoli florets for 10 minutes, then blend with half the butter, the Parmesan, salt and pepper.
Cook the patties for 3 minutes per side in a hot pan with 10 g butter. Keep warm.
In the same pan, sauté the sliced mushrooms and garlic with the remaining butter for 5 minutes.
Pour in the cream, let it thicken for 2 minutes, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve the patties topped with sauce and sprinkled with chives, with the broccoli mash.
l04-steaks-haches-champignons-puree-broc.p: Parmesan broccoli mash often appeals to kids who turn up their noses at whole vegetables.

l04-lasagnes-aubergine-agneau-ricotta.t: Eggplant Lasagna with Lamb and Mint
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 5 mm slices, brush with oil, salt, and roast for 15 minutes.
Cook the chopped onion, add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, spices and tomatoes; simmer for 15 minutes.
Mix the ricotta with the chopped mint, salt and pepper.
Lower the oven to 180°C. Layer in a baking dish: eggplant, lamb, ricotta, making 3 layers.
Cover with mozzarella and bake for 25 minutes.
Let rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
l04-lasagnes-aubergine-agneau-ricotta.p: A lighter take on moussaka, with a fresh touch from the mint.

s: Spiralize the zucchini into spaghetti, salt lightly and let drain for 10 minutes.
Sear the beef strips dusted with paprika in half the butter over very high heat for 1 to 2 minutes, in 2 batches. Set aside.
Cook the sliced onion and mushrooms in the remaining butter for 6 minutes.
Add the crème fraîche and mustard, simmer for 2 minutes, then return the meat and its juices. Season with salt and pepper.
Pan-fry the zucchini noodles for 2 minutes over high heat and blot them dry.
Serve the beef over the noodles, sprinkled with parsley.
l04-boeuf-stroganoff.p: Don't let the sauce boil after adding the meat back, so it stays tender.

l04-hachis-agneau-celeri-gratine.t: Lamb Shepherd's Pie with Celeriac and Cauliflower Mash
s: Boil the cauliflower and celeriac, in pieces, for 20 minutes in salted water. Drain thoroughly.
Blend with the butter and warm cream into a smooth mash; season with salt and pepper.
Cook the chopped onion, add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, herbs, tomato paste and broth; reduce for 8 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Spread the lamb in a baking dish, cover with the mash and score the surface with a fork.
Sprinkle with Parmesan and bake for 20 minutes until the top is golden.
l04-hachis-agneau-celeri-gratine.p: Celeriac tastes a bit like potato; mixed with cauliflower, it stays low in carbs.

s: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool them and peel.
Sear the oiled and salted steak for 3 minutes per side. Let rest for 5 minutes, then slice.
Mix the mayonnaise, lemon juice, mustard, grated garlic, half of the grated Parmesan and a little pepper; thin with 1 tbsp water.
Tear the romaine into pieces and toss with the dressing.
Top with the meat, the eggs in quarters and the Parmesan shavings.
l04-salade-cesar-boeuf.p: For crunch, add Parmesan crisps: small mounds of grated Parmesan baked for 6 minutes at 200°C.

l04-boulettes-boeuf-sauce-coco-curry.t: Beef Meatballs in Coconut Curry Sauce
s: Mix the beef with the egg, half the chopped cilantro, half the ginger, 1 grated garlic clove and salt. Shape into 20 meatballs.
Brown them in the coconut oil for 6 minutes, then set aside.
In the same deep skillet, cook the remaining garlic and ginger with the curry for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and coconut milk, return the meatballs; simmer for 12 minutes, covered.
Stir in the spinach for 2 minutes, sprinkle with the remaining cilantro and serve.
l04-boulettes-boeuf-sauce-coco-curry.p: Serve with rinsed, pan-fried konjac noodles for a complete meal.

l04-veau-saltimbocca-dinde-fumee.t: Veal Saltimbocca with Smoked Turkey and Sage
s: Flatten the escalopes, season with pepper, top each with a slice of smoked turkey and a sage leaf; secure with a toothpick.
Heat the oil and half the butter, sear the escalopes turkey side down for 1 minute 30 seconds, then the other side for 1 minute. Set aside.
Deglaze with the broth and lemon juice, reduce for 2 minutes, then add the remaining butter.
Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes with the crushed garlic in another pan.
Serve the saltimbocca drizzled with the sauce, with the spinach.
l04-veau-saltimbocca-dinde-fumee.p: No need for salt: the smoked turkey already seasons the meat.

l04-merguez-shakshuka-feta.t: Merguez Baked Eggs with Feta and Spinach
s: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Slice the merguez and brown them for 6 minutes in an ovenproof skillet.
Remove the excess fat, add the oil, garlic and spinach; let it wilt for 3 minutes.
Pour in the cream and crumble in half the feta.
Make 6 wells and crack an egg into each. Crumble the remaining feta around them.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Sprinkle with chives and pepper before serving.
l04-merguez-shakshuka-feta.p: Without an oven, cover the pan and cook over low heat for 8 minutes.

i: 2 kg bone-in lamb shoulder (~1.5 kg meat)
s: Preheat the oven to 120°C. Rub the shoulder with oil, salt, pepper and herbs.
Place it in a Dutch oven on top of the onion cut into wedges, with the head of garlic halved crosswise.
Pour in the broth and lemon juice, and cover tightly (aluminum foil under the lid).
Roast for 7 hours without opening; baste once halfway through if possible.
Raise the heat to 220°C, uncover and brown for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the green beans for 8 minutes in salted water.
Shred the meat with a spoon, drizzle with the juices and serve with the green beans and the soft roasted garlic cloves.
l04-epaule-agneau-confite-7h.p: Start cooking in the morning for dinner, or the night before for a weekend lunch.

s: Steam the cauliflower florets for 8 minutes; they should stay slightly firm.
Cook the chopped onion in the oil, add the beef and brown for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, oregano and tomatoes; simmer for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Toss the cauliflower with the crème fraîche, salt and pepper.
Spread the Bolognese in a baking dish and top with the creamy cauliflower.
Cover with Emmental and bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbly.
l04-chou-fleur-gratin-boeuf-bolognaise.p: Replace half of the cauliflower with broccoli to vary the colors.

l04-pave-boeuf-sauce-cheddar-choux-bruxe.t: Beef Steak with Melted Cheddar Sauce and Brussels Sprouts
s: Halve the Brussels sprouts and blanch for 4 minutes in salted water. Drain.
Pan-fry them cut side down in the butter for 6 minutes until well browned; add the crushed walnuts at the end of cooking.
Salt the steaks and sear them in very hot oil for 3 minutes per side. Set aside under foil.
In the meat pan, heat the cream with the mustard, add the cheddar and whisk until smooth.
Serve the steaks topped with the sauce, with the Brussels sprouts.
l04-pave-boeuf-sauce-cheddar-choux-bruxe.p: Browning Brussels sprouts well takes away their bitterness: it's the secret to getting people to like them.

l04-saute-agneau-courgettes-citron-confi.t: Lamb Stew with Zucchini, Preserved Lemon and Olives
s: Brown the lamb cubes in the oil in 2 batches, 5 minutes each, then set aside.
Cook the sliced onion for 4 minutes, add the garlic and herbs.
Return the meat, pour in the broth and simmer for 40 minutes, covered, over low heat.
Add the zucchini in large chunks, the olives and the preserved lemon rind cut into strips. Continue cooking for 15 minutes, uncovered.
Sprinkle with parsley and pepper; taste before salting, as the olives and preserved lemon are already salty.
l04-saute-agneau-courgettes-citron-confi.p: A quick, Provençal-style lamb stew, with no tagine cooking required.

l05-sardines-four-salsa-verde.t: Oven-Roasted Sardines with Parsley-Gherkin Salsa Verde
s: Preheat the oven to 220°C (210°C fan) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Rinse the gutted sardines under cold water and pat them thoroughly dry with paper towels.
Arrange them side by side on the sheet, brush with 1 tbsp oil, and season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes, until the skin is golden and the flesh flakes away from the bone.
Meanwhile, finely chop the parsley, gherkins and garlic. Mix with the lemon juice, mustard and remaining oil.
Serve the sardines topped with salsa verde, with the dressed green salad on the side.
l05-sardines-four-salsa-verde.p: Ask the fishmonger to gut and scale the sardines. The salsa verde keeps for 2 days in the fridge in a jar.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Cut 4 large rectangles of parchment paper (40 × 30 cm).
Cut the zucchini into thin slices (3 mm) with a knife or mandoline.
Divide the slices in the center of each sheet, drizzle with oil, season with salt and pepper, and add the sliced garlic.
Place a salmon fillet on top, add 2 thin lemon slices, the dill and the remaining oil.
Close the parcels by folding the edges over several times so they are well sealed.
Bake for 18 to 20 minutes. Serve closed, so everyone opens their own at the table.
l05-papillote-saumon-courgette-citron.p: The parcels can be prepared in the morning and kept in the refrigerator; add 3 minutes to the cooking time.

l05-curry-crevettes-coco.t: Shrimp Curry with Coconut Milk and Spinach
s: Heat the coconut oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the finely chopped onion for 4 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger, then the curry powder; stir for 1 minute until the spices are fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk, add salt and simmer for 8 minutes to thicken the sauce slightly.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until pink and firm.
Stir in the spinach and let it wilt for 1 minute. Add the lemon juice.
Sprinkle with cilantro and serve with cauliflower rice.
l05-curry-crevettes-coco.p: Frozen shrimp work well: thaw them in the refrigerator and pat them dry before cooking.

l05-gratin-merlan-epinards.t: Whiting and Spinach Gratin in Cream Sauce
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and butter a gratin dish.
Wilt the spinach for 4 minutes in a pan with the butter and chopped garlic, then squeeze out the water.
Spread the spinach in the dish. Lay the whiting fillets on top, season with salt and pepper.
Mix the crème fraîche with the nutmeg, salt and pepper, and spoon it over the fish.
Sprinkle with Emmental and bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until the top is golden.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
l05-gratin-merlan-epinards.p: Squeezing the spinach well prevents a watery gratin. Cod works too.

l05-tartare-saumon-avocat.t: Salmon Tartare with Avocado and Lime
s: Place the salmon in the freezer for 20 minutes to firm it up, which makes cutting easier.
Cut the salmon into small 5 mm cubes with a very sharp knife and keep refrigerated.
Dice the avocado flesh and sprinkle with a little lime juice to keep it from turning brown.
Very finely chop the red onion and snip the chives.
Just before serving, mix the salmon, onion, chives, oil, remaining lime juice, salt and pepper.
Plate using a ring mold: a layer of avocado, then the salmon. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve on the salad greens.
l05-tartare-saumon-avocat.p: Use very fresh salmon (sashimi grade) or salmon previously frozen for 48 hours at -18°C. Season at the last moment. Raw fish: not recommended for pregnant women, children under 5, and elderly or vulnerable people.

l05-burgers-thon-salade.t: Tuna Burgers in Lettuce Wraps with Tartar Sauce
i: cans of tuna in water, drained (140 g)
s: Drain the tuna well and flake it with a fork in a large bowl.
Add the eggs, almond flour, parsley, sliced scallions, salt and pepper. Mix and let rest for 10 minutes.
With wet hands, shape 8 patties 2 cm thick.
Brown them for 4 minutes on each side in hot oil over medium heat, without moving them too soon.
Mix the mayonnaise with the chopped gherkins to make the tartar sauce.
Serve each patty between two large lettuce leaves with a tomato slice and the sauce.
l05-burgers-thon-salade.p: Cooked patties keep for 3 days in the fridge and can be reheated in a pan: ideal for lunch boxes.

l05-dorade-four-fenouil.t: Whole Roasted Sea Bream with Fennel and Lemon
i: gutted and scaled sea bream (600 g each)
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Thinly slice the fennel and spread it in a large dish with 2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper.
Roast the fennel on its own for 10 minutes so it starts to soften.
Meanwhile, rinse and pat dry the sea bream. Score the skin 3 times on each side.
Stuff the cavity with lemon slices, crushed garlic and a few sprigs of parsley.
Place the sea bream on the fennel, add the olives, drizzle with the remaining oil, and season with salt.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes: the flesh should be opaque and come away easily from the central bone.
Lift the fillets at the table and serve with the tender fennel and the juices from the dish.
l05-dorade-four-fenouil.p: Allow about 300 g of whole fish per person. Sea bass is prepared in exactly the same way.

l05-calamars-poeles-ail-persil.t: Pan-Fried Squid with Garlic and Parsley, Arugula Salad
s: Cut the squid into 1 cm rings and leave the tentacles whole. Pat them very thoroughly dry.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat until it shimmers.
Sear the squid in two batches, 2 minutes per batch, without stirring at first so they brown.
Return everything to the pan, add the chopped garlic and chili, and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped parsley and lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately over the arugula dressed with the remaining oil, with the Parmesan shavings.
l05-calamars-poeles-ail-persil.p: Short, very high-heat cooking avoids rubbery squid: either 2 minutes, or over 40 minutes in a stew.

l05-moules-creme-ail.t: Mussels in Cream with Garlic and Parsley
i: kg of mussels in the shell
s: Scrub and rinse the mussels in cold water and remove the beards. Discard any that are broken or stay open.
In a large pot, melt the butter and sweat the chopped onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the mussels and broth, cover and cook over high heat for 5 to 6 minutes, shaking the pot.
When all the mussels have opened, remove them with a slotted spoon and keep warm.
Pour the cream into the cooking liquid, reduce for 3 minutes, season with pepper and add the parsley.
Spoon the sauce over the mussels and serve in shallow bowls.
l05-moules-creme-ail.p: Discard any mussels that stay closed after cooking. No need to add salt: mussels are naturally salty.

l05-saumon-croute-amandes.t: Almond and Mustard Crusted Salmon with Green Beans
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Place the fillets skin side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops of the fillets with mustard.
Mix the almond flour, Parmesan, parsley and oil until it resembles wet sand; press it onto the mustard.
Bake for 15 to 18 minutes until the crust is golden.
Meanwhile, cook the green beans for 8 minutes in salted boiling water, drain and toss with butter.
Serve the salmon with the peppered green beans.
l05-saumon-croute-amandes.p: Add a little lemon zest to the crust for extra freshness.

l05-salade-thon-oeufs-haricots.t: Main-Course Tuna Salad with Soft-Boiled Eggs and Green Beans
i: cans of tuna in oil, drained
s: Lower the eggs into boiling water for 6 minutes, then into ice water. Peel gently.
Cook the green beans for 7 minutes in salted boiling water, then cool them in cold water.
Make the vinaigrette by whisking mustard, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper.
Arrange the lettuce on plates, add the beans, halved cherry tomatoes and olives.
Flake the tuna over the top and add the halved eggs.
Drizzle with vinaigrette when serving.
l05-salade-thon-oeufs-haricots.p: For lunch boxes: keep the vinaigrette in a small separate jar.

l05-maquereau-four-moutarde.t: Mustard Baked Mackerel with Roasted Cauliflower
s: Preheat the oven to 210°C. Cut the cauliflower into small florets.
Toss the florets with 2 tbsp oil, the paprika, salt and pepper, spread on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes.
Mix the mustard with the remaining oil and the lemon juice.
Brush the flesh of the mackerel fillets with this mixture.
Push the cauliflower to the sides, place the fillets skin side down in the center and roast for 10 more minutes.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve piping hot.
l05-maquereau-four-moutarde.p: Mackerel, rich in omega-3, is one of the cheapest fish on the market: perfect for a budget-friendly dinner.

l05-cabillaud-beurre-citron-brocoli.t: Pan-Seared Cod with Lemon Butter and Broccoli
s: Cut the broccoli into florets and steam them for 5 minutes.
Pat the cod dry, and season with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat the oil in a pan over medium-high heat and add the fish. Let it brown for 4 minutes without touching it.
Flip, add the butter and crushed garlic; spoon the foaming butter over the fish for 3 minutes.
Remove the fish, add the lemon juice and chives to the butter, and toss the broccoli in it for 1 minute.
Serve the cod topped with the lemon butter, with the broccoli.
l05-cabillaud-beurre-citron-brocoli.p: The fish is done when the flesh turns pearly and separates into flakes.

l05-salade-crevettes-avocat-cocktail.t: Shrimp, Avocado and Cucumber Salad with Cocktail Sauce
s: Poach the shrimp for 2 to 3 minutes in simmering salted water, then drain and cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato paste, paprika and half the lemon juice to make the cocktail sauce.
Dice the cucumber and avocado, and drizzle with the remaining lemon juice.
Separate the lettuce leaves and arrange them on plates.
Add the cucumber, avocado and shrimp, top with cocktail sauce and sprinkle with dill.
l05-salade-crevettes-avocat-cocktail.p: Make the sauce ahead: it tastes better after 1 hour in the fridge.

l05-sardines-panees-amande.t: Almond and Parmesan Breaded Sardines with Lemon Mayonnaise
s: Ask for sardines butterflied, with the central bone removed. Rinse and pat them well dry.
Beat the eggs in a shallow dish. In another, mix the almond flour, Parmesan, spices, salt and pepper.
Dip each sardine in the egg, then in the breading, pressing to coat well.
Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Brown the sardines for 2 to 3 minutes per side, in small batches.
Drain them on paper towels.
Mix the mayonnaise with the lemon zest and half the juice. Serve with sliced cucumber sprinkled with the remaining lemon juice.
l05-sardines-panees-amande.p: Almond breading burns faster than breadcrumbs: keep the heat at medium and don't overcrowd the pan.

l05-saumon-teriyaki-wok.t: Teriyaki-Style Salmon with Crunchy Vegetable Stir-Fry
s: Mix the soy sauce, erythritol, ginger, grated garlic and 2 tbsp water: this is the teriyaki sauce.
Cut the salmon into large 4 cm cubes and the vegetables into strips or small florets.
Sear the salmon for 2 minutes per side in 1 tbsp very hot oil, then set aside.
In the same wok, stir-fry the vegetables for 4 to 5 minutes over high heat with the remaining oil: they should stay crunchy.
Return the salmon, pour in the sauce and let it reduce for 1 to 2 minutes, gently coating the fish.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions and serve immediately.
l05-saumon-teriyaki-wok.p: Serve with konjac rice, rinsed and dry-fried for 3 minutes, for a more complete meal.

l05-thon-mi-cuit-sesame-salade-chou.t: Seared Sesame-Crusted Tuna with Ginger Cabbage Salad
s: Very thinly slice both cabbages and place them in a large bowl.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, ginger and 2 tbsp oil; pour over the cabbage, toss and marinate for 15 minutes.
Lightly salt the tuna loins, season with pepper, then roll them in the sesame seeds, pressing.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan over very high heat. Sear the tuna for 1 minute on each side: the center should stay pink.
Let rest for 2 minutes, then slice into 1 cm slices with a very sharp knife.
Serve the tuna over the cabbage salad sprinkled with cilantro.
l05-thon-mi-cuit-sesame-salade-chou.p: If you prefer well-done tuna, allow 3 minutes per side, but it will be drier.

l05-loup-poele-sauce-vierge.t: Pan-Seared Sea Bass Fillets with Sauce Vierge and Grilled Zucchini
s: Make the sauce vierge: seed and finely dice the tomatoes, add the chopped olives, shredded basil, chopped garlic, lemon and 3 tbsp oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Cut the zucchini lengthwise into 5 mm slices and grill for 2 minutes per side in a grill pan with a drizzle of oil.
Lightly score the skin of the sea bass fillets so they don't curl. Pat dry and salt.
Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium-high heat and place the fillets skin side down. Press them for 30 seconds with a spatula.
Cook for 4 minutes skin side down until crisp, flip and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the fillets skin side up over the zucchini, topped with sauce vierge.
l05-loup-poele-sauce-vierge.p: Sauce vierge is best at room temperature: make it 30 minutes ahead so the flavors blend.

l05-crevettes-beurre-ail-spaghettis-cour.t: Garlic Butter Shrimp with Zucchini Spaghetti
s: Cut the zucchini into spaghetti with a spiralizer or julienne peeler. Salt lightly and let drain for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat the oil and half the butter in a large pan over high heat. Sear the shrimp for 1 minute per side, set aside.
Lower the heat, add the remaining butter, the chopped garlic and chili; let it foam for 1 minute without browning the garlic.
Add the zucchini spaghetti and stir-fry for 2 minutes: they should stay slightly crisp.
Return the shrimp, add the lemon and parsley, and season with pepper.
Serve immediately with the grated Parmesan.
l05-crevettes-beurre-ail-spaghettis-cour.p: Don't overcook the zucchini spaghetti, or they release water and turn mushy.

s: Cut the squid tubes into 4 cm squares and lightly score the inside with the tip of a knife.
Mix the oil, paprika, cumin, grated garlic, half the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Add the squid and shrimp, and marinate for 20 minutes in the fridge.
Cut the bell pepper into 3 cm squares. If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 20 minutes.
Thread, alternating squid, shrimp and bell pepper.
Grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side on a very hot grill or plancha.
Drizzle with the remaining lemon juice, sprinkle with parsley and serve with the salad.
l05-brochettes-calamars-crevettes.p: These skewers can also be cooked on the barbecue: the smoked paprika marinade gives them an even stronger grilled flavor.

s: Boil the cauliflower florets for 12 minutes in salted water, until very tender. Drain thoroughly.
Meanwhile, poach the cod for 8 minutes in the simmering milk-water mixture with the garlic. Drain (discard the liquid) and flake the fish.
Blend the cauliflower with the crème fraîche, oil and the poached garlic until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Gently fold the mash with the flaked cod and the parsley.
Pour into a gratin dish, smooth the top and sprinkle with Parmesan.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until the top is nicely golden.
l05-brandade-cabillaud-chou-fleur.p: The brandade can be prepared the day before and browned at the last moment. It also freezes very well in portions.

l05-salade-saumon-fume-avocat-oeuf.t: Smoked Salmon, Avocado, Poached Egg and Arugula Salad
s: Bring a pot of water to a simmer with the vinegar. Crack each egg into a cup.
Create a whirlpool with a spoon, slide an egg in and poach for 3 minutes. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Repeat.
Whisk the oil, lemon, dill, salt and pepper.
Divide the arugula, avocado slices and cucumber among the plates.
Add the smoked salmon in ribbons and place a poached egg on each plate.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and season generously with pepper.
l05-salade-saumon-fume-avocat-oeuf.p: Not comfortable with poached eggs? A soft-boiled egg (6 minutes in boiling water) will work perfectly.

s: Boil the cauliflower florets for 12 minutes in salted water. Drain well, then blend with the butter and cream. Season with salt and pepper, keep warm.
Cut the whiting fillets into portions and pat dry.
Beat the egg in a shallow dish. Mix the almond flour, Parmesan, salt and pepper in another.
Dip the fish in the egg, then in the breading.
Brown for 3 minutes per side in hot oil over medium heat.
Serve the whiting with the mash sprinkled with chives.
l05-merlan-pane-puree-chou-fleur.p: For an oven version: 15 minutes at 200°C on parchment paper, with a drizzle of oil on top.

l05-moules-gratinees-parmesan.t: Mussels Gratin with Parsley Butter and Parmesan
i: kg of mussels in the shell
s: Clean the mussels, then open them for 5 minutes over high heat in a covered pot, with no liquid.
Remove the empty shell from each mussel and arrange the filled half-shells on a baking sheet.
Blend or mash with a fork the softened butter with the garlic, chopped parsley and pepper.
Place a small knob of parsley butter on each mussel, then sprinkle with the Parmesan and almond flour mixture.
Broil in the oven at 230°C for 5 to 7 minutes, until golden and sizzling.
Serve immediately with the green salad dressed with olive oil.
l05-moules-gratinees-parmesan.p: The parsley butter can be made ahead and frozen as a log in plastic wrap: handy for sea snails or grilled fish.

l05-maquereau-grille-sauce-yaourt.t: Grilled Mackerel with Cucumber-Mint Yogurt Sauce
s: Grate the cucumber and squeeze it in a kitchen towel to remove the water.
Mix it into the yogurt with the chopped mint, grated garlic, salt and pepper. Keep refrigerated.
Brush the mackerel fillets with oil, sprinkle with cumin and season with salt.
Grill for 3 minutes skin side down, then 1 to 2 minutes flesh side down on a very hot grill pan.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve over the arugula with the yogurt sauce.
l05-maquereau-grille-sauce-yaourt.p: The yogurt-cucumber sauce keeps for 2 days in the fridge. Add a pinch of chili for the adults.

i: cans of tuna in water, drained
s: Preheat the oven to 190°C. Use a 26 cm ovenproof skillet.
Cook the sliced onion for 4 minutes in the oil, add the spinach and let it wilt for 2 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the cream, salt and pepper.
Spread the flaked tuna in the pan, pour in the eggs, add the crumbled feta and the halved cherry tomatoes.
Let it set for 3 minutes over low heat, then bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the center is set.
Let cool for 5 minutes, cut into wedges and serve with a salad.
l05-frittata-thon-epinards.p: Delicious cold: a slice in a lunch box with a few raw vegetables makes a complete lunch.

l05-papillote-dorade-tomates-olives.t: Sea Bream Parcels with Cherry Tomatoes, Olives and Basil
s: Preheat the oven to 200°C and prepare 4 sheets of parchment paper.
Cut the zucchini into thin half-moons and divide them in the center of the sheets.
Place a sea bream fillet on each bed of zucchini, season with salt and pepper.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes, olives, sliced garlic and a slice of lemon.
Drizzle with olive oil and seal tightly into parcels.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes. Sprinkle with fresh basil when opening.
l05-papillote-dorade-tomates-olives.p: You can replace the sea bream with whiting, which is cheaper: reduce the cooking time to 15 minutes.

l05-saumon-sauce-aneth-asperges.t: Pan-Seared Salmon with Cream-Dill Sauce and Roasted Asparagus
s: Preheat the oven to 210°C. Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus, place on a baking sheet with 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper, and roast for 12 minutes.
Salt the salmon fillets. Heat the remaining oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Place the salmon skin side down and cook for 5 minutes without touching, then flip and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove the salmon. Pour the cream and mustard into the pan and reduce for 2 minutes.
Off the heat, add the dill and lemon juice, and season with pepper.
Serve the salmon over the asparagus, topped with the sauce.
l05-saumon-sauce-aneth-asperges.p: Out of asparagus season, use green beans or broccoli roasted the same way.

l05-rillettes-sardines-concombre.t: Sardine Rillettes with Cream Cheese on Cucumber Boats
i: cans of sardines in oil, drained
s: Drain the sardines and remove the central bone if you like.
Mash them with a fork with the cream cheese, mustard, lemon juice, salt, pepper and the chopped chives.
Halve the cucumbers lengthwise and scoop out the seeds with a small spoon.
Fill the cucumber boats with the rillettes and dust with paprika.
Serve with the hard-boiled eggs cut into wedges and the radishes.
l05-rillettes-sardines-concombre.p: The rillettes keep for 3 days in the fridge in a jar: also perfect as a snack on seed crackers.

l05-poke-bowl-saumon-chou-fleur.t: Salmon Poke Bowl with Cauliflower Rice and Avocado
s: Pulse the cauliflower into rice-sized grains. Dry-fry for 4 minutes in a pan, season with vinegar and let cool.
Cut the salmon into 1.5 cm cubes and marinate for 10 minutes in the fridge in the soy sauce and oil.
Slice the avocado and cucumber, and thinly slice the red cabbage.
Mix the mayonnaise and chili for a spicy mayo.
Divide the cauliflower rice among 4 bowls, then arrange the salmon, avocado, cucumber and red cabbage in sections.
Add the nori cut into strips, the sesame seeds and a drizzle of spicy mayo.
l05-poke-bowl-saumon-chou-fleur.p: Raw salmon must be very fresh or previously frozen for 48 hours. Replace it with raw tuna or cooked shrimp depending on the market. Raw fish: not recommended for pregnant women, young children, and elderly or vulnerable people.

l05-cabillaud-curry-vert-courgettes.t: Cod in Green Curry Sauce with Zucchini and Basil
s: Blend the cilantro, half the basil, the chili, ginger, garlic and lime juice with 2 tbsp coconut milk: this is the homemade green curry paste.
Cook the paste for 2 minutes in the coconut oil over medium heat.
Pour in the remaining coconut milk and the soy sauce, bring to a simmer.
Add the zucchini in half-moons and the bell pepper in strips, and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the cod cubes to the sauce and poach for 5 to 6 minutes over low heat, stirring gently so they stay whole.
Sprinkle with the remaining basil and serve.
l05-cabillaud-curry-vert-courgettes.p: Adjust the chili for the kids: remove the seeds or use half.

s: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Thinly slice the white part of the leek and the mushrooms. Cook them for 6 minutes in the butter until the water has evaporated.
Add the squid and cook for 2 minutes, then the shrimp for 1 minute.
Off the heat, stir in the mussels, crème fraîche, parsley, salt and pepper.
Divide among 4 individual dishes or one gratin dish and cover with Emmental.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbling.
l05-gratin-fruits-de-mer-poireau.p: A frozen seafood mix works very well: thaw it and drain it thoroughly before using.

l05-sardines-grillees-salade-poivrons.t: Plancha-Grilled Sardines with Roasted Pepper Salad
s: Roast the whole peppers under the oven broiler or over a flame for 15 minutes, turning them, until the skin blackens.
Place them in a bag or covered bowl for 10 minutes, then peel, seed and cut into strips.
Season the peppers with chopped garlic, vinegar, 2 tbsp oil and parsley.
Rinse and dry the sardines, rub with coarse salt and a little oil.
Grill on a plancha or very hot grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side, until the skin is crisp.
Serve immediately with the pepper salad.
l05-sardines-grillees-salade-poivrons.p: Very fresh whole grilled sardines don't need to be gutted; ask for them scaled.

l05-tacos-laitue-crevettes-guacamole.t: Lettuce Tacos with Spicy Shrimp and Guacamole
s: Make the guacamole: mash the avocados with half the lime juice, the finely chopped red onion, the diced tomato, half the cilantro and salt.
Toss the shrimp with the spices, oil and a pinch of salt.
Sauté them for 3 minutes over high heat in a pan, until pink and golden.
Drizzle with the remaining lime juice.
Fill each lettuce leaf with red cabbage, shrimp and a spoonful of guacamole, then sprinkle with cilantro.
l05-tacos-laitue-crevettes-guacamole.p: Let everyone assemble their own tacos at the table: kids love it.

l05-loup-croute-sel-legumes.t: Herb Salt-Crusted Sea Bass with Steamed Vegetables in Olive Oil
i: gutted, unscaled sea bass (600 g each)
s: Preheat the oven to 220°C. Mix the coarse salt with the egg whites and 2 tbsp water to get a wet sand texture.
Slip the herbs and a few lemon slices into the belly of the fish.
Spread a 1 cm layer of salt in a dish, place the fish on it and cover completely with salt, packing it down.
Bake for 30 to 35 minutes.
Meanwhile, steam the broccoli and green beans for 8 minutes.
Crack the crust with the back of a spoon, remove the skin and lift off the fillets.
Serve with the vegetables dressed with olive oil, lemon and pepper.
l05-loup-croute-sel-legumes.p: The salt is not eaten: it creates a steam oven that keeps the flesh very moist and perfectly seasoned.

l05-calamars-farcis-sauce-tomate.t: Squid Stuffed with Spinach and Feta in Tomato Sauce
s: Chop the squid tentacles. Cook them for 2 minutes in 1 tbsp oil with the chopped garlic, then add the spinach and let it wilt for 3 minutes. Squeeze out the water.
Mix this filling with the crumbled feta, egg, parsley and pepper.
Fill the tubes two-thirds full with a small spoon (the filling expands) and close with a toothpick.
Brown the stuffed squid for 2 minutes on each side in the remaining oil.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and oregano, salt lightly, cover and simmer for 30 minutes over low heat.
Remove the toothpicks and serve topped with the sauce.
l05-calamars-farcis-sauce-tomate.p: Long, gentle cooking makes squid very tender. The dish is even better reheated the next day.

l05-salade-nicoise-thon-frais.t: Niçoise Salad with Seared Fresh Tuna
s: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel them.
Cook the green beans for 6 minutes in salted water and cool them.
Brush the tuna with 1 tbsp oil, season with salt and pepper, and sear for 2 minutes per side in a very hot pan. Slice it.
Cut the tomatoes into wedges, the bell pepper into thin strips, the radishes into slices.
Arrange the vegetables, olives, quartered eggs and tuna on the lettuce.
Drizzle with a vinaigrette made from the remaining oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
l05-salade-nicoise-thon-frais.p: Budget version: replace the fresh tuna with 2 cans of tuna in oil.
